notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to green is at least seven.
description:
Activate Nykthos' second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, adding at least seven {G}.
Activate Whip Silk by paying {G}, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Cast Whip Silk by paying {G}, targeting any creature.
Malachite Talisman triggers, causing you to pay {3} to untap Nykthos.
Repeat.
If your devotion to green is at least eight, this combo nets infinite mana, and you may then target any other permanent using Malachite Talisman's ability.
